record_title: Quantitative near-eigenfunction rigidity for the sharp centered maximal inequality
limitations: The stability exponent is not claimed optimal; no spatial classification or full concentration-compactness theorem is obtained; the argument is one-dimensional; the dyadic-radii result concerns Madrid's centered geometric family rather than a dyadic-grid maximal operator; the 2010 uncentered eigenfunction paper was not independently rechecked in full; a contemporaneous unindexed refinement may exist; independent audit has not been performed.
